title: Bandwidth sensitivity and RDD robustness checks
research_question: Using the Russell 1000/2000 index reconstitution cutoff, does index membership affect institutional ownership, and is the RDD estimate robust to bandwidth choice?
data_description: Cross-sectional data on 600 firms near the Russell 1000/2000 boundary. Variables: running_var (end-of-May market cap rank, normalized; cutoff = 0.5), treated (1 = Russell 2000 member i.e. just below cutoff), y (institutional ownership fraction), near_cutoff. Must test: bandwidth sensitivity, polynomial order sensitivity, placebo cutoffs.
